iOS 27.2 beta 2 is launching today, and at first glance the changes for users don't seem significant. However, the code in the iOS 27.2 beta version shows that Apple Music, CarPlay Ultra, and other features all have new developments underway.

Leaker discovers hidden iOS 27.2 features in beta code

Every time Apple releases a new beta of its software, we usually find changes through two avenues: first, user interface features already enabled within the software, and second, underlying code modifications, which often foreshadow upcoming new features.

iOS 27.2 already had a range of new features available for testing on day one, such as a completely new Health app, user profiles for Apple TV, expanded Siri AI capabilities, and more.

However, users familiar with the underlying code have uncovered even more changes in the pipeline.

For instance, X user pdfu discovered that Apple Music will introduce a live countdown feature for new album releases.

pdfu also found another discovery within the iOS 27.2 beta code, this time related to the Shortcuts app.

The new "Describe a Shortcut" feature in Shortcuts appears close to supporting the addition of actions from third-party apps.

Another notable discovery in the iOS 27.2 code relates to CarPlay Ultra.

Aaron Perris found references in the code to a "Driving Mode theme" that can change the instrument cluster style and colors, and even sync with the car's ambient lighting.

CarPlay Ultra currently remains exclusive to Aston Martin vehicles. However, the addition of theme features may indicate that Apple will soon extend support to other car manufacturers.

We previously reported that iOS 27.2 will introduce a more thorough data wiping feature for iPhone. The beta 2 released today further describes this new feature — now renamed "Extended Erase" — also discovered by Aaron Perris.

Finally, Perris found evidence suggesting Apple may be preparing a demo mode for its upcoming smart home device, the "HomePad".

Among the new features and upcoming features in iOS 27.2, which one are you most looking forward to? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
